text: ぼくは　しぜんを　まもるけど　しぜんに　まもられても　いるんだ！

structure.jp: ぼくは　しぜんを　まもるけど
しぜんに　まもられても　いるんだ！
structure.en: I'm also being protected by nature!

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.span: しぜんに　まもられて
patterns.explanation: られる on a verb turns it around so the action is done to you, and に shows who does it. しぜんに　まもられて = 'being protected by nature'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.span: まもられても　いる
patterns.explanation: ている says something is ongoing; も slipped in the middle adds 'also'. まもられても　いる = 'am also being protected'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the spoken form of のだ and gives an explaining, earnest tone. いるんだ = 'I am, you see'.
